# Pandamonium v1.0.59

Chat and project rows in the Chats sidebar now sit flush left at rest: the move handle no longer reserves a gutter, so project folders and chats line up with the Projects label and the rest of the sidebar.

## MAD-944 — Projects: keep chat and project rows flush left in the Chats sidebar

### Problem

Live acceptance of MAD-920 on v1.0.56: the hidden ⠿ move handle still occupied layout space in every chat and project row, so folder icons and chat icons were indented about 18px relative to the Projects label and the other sidebar rows. The reference layout (Codex) starts project folders and chat rows flush at the left edge, with no drag handle in layout at rest.

### Implementation

`static/style.css` only: the chat and project drag handles are absolutely positioned over the row's left edge with zero layout width and `pointer-events: none` at rest. They reveal on row hover, handle `:focus-visible`, an active drag, or `body.rearrange-mode` — the same reveal behavior as the section headers from MAD-908. While the handle is visible, only the row's left-side content (provider star, type icon, label, and the folder icon and name) translates 16px to make room; right-side actions (favorite star, session menu, project `+`/`×`) keep their positions and hit targets. Touch layouts keep the handle available without hover.

### Product value and UI visibility

The Chats section now reads like the rest of the sidebar and the Codex reference: project folder icons line up with the Projects label and chat rows keep only their folder indent. The move handle appears exactly when the row is hovered, focused for keyboard reordering, dragged, or rearrange mode is on.

### Verification

The hidden-handle source guard in `tests/test_projects_in_chats.py` asserts the absolute, zero-layout handle with no `flex-shrink` gutter; `tests/browser/mad-820-sidebar-organization.spec.js` asserts the geometry (folder icon x equals the Projects label x within 2px; a nested chat is exactly 22px from the folder icon, down from 40px with the gutter). Focused runs: 13 Python checks and 24 browser tests passed; PR #175 CI is green.

### Configuration, compatibility, and limitations

Frontend-only change: no dependency, API, database, or data migration. Session and project ordering, bindings, and drag/keyboard reorder behavior are unchanged.
